content.text: FacebookLog InLog InForgot Account?Actresses World's PostActresses World3d · Shared with PublicEuphoria season 3 premieres on Sunday, April 12, 2026, with 8 episodes airing weekly on Sundays and the finale set for May 31, 2026. HBO’s rollout schedule is: Episode 1 “Ándale” — April 12; Episode 2 “America My Dream” — April 19; Episode 3 “The Ballad of Paladin” — April 26; Episode 4 “Kitty Likes to Dance” — May 3; Episode 5 “This Little Piggy” — May 10; Episode 6 “Stand Still and See” — May 17; Episode 7 “Rain or Shine” — May 24; Episode 8 “In God We Trust” — May 31.
